anti_overlap: fd-compute-supply-chain-realism covers whether the TSMC 92% concentration and CHIPS Act export controls are modeled with real-world accuracy
fd-compute-signal-consumer-contracts covers how technology, economy, and military modules consume compute signals
fd-compute-strategic-bottleneck-balance covers whether the compounding-advantage mechanic produces interesting player decisions
decision_lens: Findings are prioritized by whether they would require re-architecting the module boundary after implementation versus a configuration change. Anything that forces coupling into the tick pipeline core (full.rs, pressure_cache.rs) without a clean seam is a P0.
focus: Whether the compute sub-system fits the existing emergence pillar pattern: signal/state separation, per-country regional tracking, and the PressureStore/IssueStore/CascadeConfig layering
name: fd-compute-module-architecture
persona: A Rust systems architect who has designed resource-constrained simulation modules and knows the Shadow Work emergence pillar inside out — PressureStore, CountryPressures, EmergenceConfig, CascadeConfig, and the tick pipeline from tick_simulation() through tick_all_scaled().
review_areas: Verify the compute module owns a ComputeStore parallel to PressureStore — per-country per-region fields (fab_capacity_nm, gpu_stockpile_units, data_center_gw, export_control_tier) — and that its state is serde-serializable and skips runtime-only caches with #[serde(skip)] like PressureStore does

Check whether compute signals are emitted as pressure amplification deltas (like collect_pressure_amplification() in issues/store/effects.rs) or as a separate signal bus — verify the chosen pattern doesn't require callers in other modules to import compute internals directly

Audit the tick integration point: compute tick should slot into tick_simulation() as a peer call (not inside pressure decay or agent action loops) and accept a DAILY_SCALE argument consistent with the existing daily cadence

Confirm CountryPressures is extended with a ComputePressure variant in PressureType::ALL or that a new PressureType enum arm is added — verify PressureType::ALL iteration still initializes the new arm in CountryPressures::new()

Assess whether CascadeConfig's neighbor graph (trade/alliance/border) is sufficient to model semiconductor supply chain contagion — Taiwan-to-South-Korea cascades are trade-type but TSMC concentration is a single-country production constraint, not a neighbor relationship
Verify the compute module has a Default impl usable by SimulationTicker::default() so restart (full replacement) clears compute state without special-casing
success_hints: The compute module compiles as a standalone emergence/ subdirectory with no imports from economy/ or state/simulation_loop/ — only from emergence/ primitives and shared types
Adding a new ComputePressure variant to PressureType causes zero non-compute files to fail compilation except the PressureType::ALL array and any exhaustive match arms
task_context: Shadow Work is a Rust/Tauri geopolitical simulation. The emergence/ pillar contains PressureStore (per-country HashMap<PressureType, f32>), EmergenceConfig (CascadeConfig with neighbor graphs), and a tick pipeline where tick_simulation() calls pressure decay via tick_all_scaled(DAILY_SCALE). New modules follow the pattern: own state type, emit pressure deltas, integrate at the tick boundary.
